verdict.rationale: Dropbox can be driven programmatically without its UI. It offers a Files API for create/read/move/delete operations, official Python and JavaScript SDKs (the JS SDK runs on Node.js 22+), and webhooks, so scripts can automate it in a CI job. However, nothing in the evidence documents a headless CLI, CI-specific guidance, or non-interactive authentication; the only auth evidence is the OAuth guide and scope customization, and no OpenAPI spec was found. Missing for 10: official CLI or headless mode, documented CI/pipeline usage, non-interactive or service-account auth guidance, and independent hands-on corroboration of CI automation.
